description: A forum thread root. Lives in the author's user repo; aggregated per-community by the forum index.

community.description: DID of the community this thread belongs to.

author.description: The member who wrote this record. Present when the record is stored in the community's repository (a private community) and not in the author's own.

importedFrom.description: Present when the thread was imported from another platform (net.openfederation.forum.importBatch). Such a thread is written by the community itself, in its own repository.
Where an imported thread came from. `createdAt` keeps the original time; the repository commit carries the time of the import.

channelId.description: The source platform's id of the channel or thread this forum thread was made from.

authorSig.description: The author's signature over this record without `authorSig`. Present together with `author`.

key.description: did:key of the author's atproto signing key.

sig.description: base64url signature over the CID of the record without `authorSig`.
